title: [DeepSeek-V4.1] Fused mHC sublayer boundary kernel (post-mix + pre-combine + RMSNorm)
body_opening:
## Motivation

In the DeepSeek-V4.1 predecessor-pre mHC scheme (`hc_pre_from_prev_sublayer`), every sublayer boundary runs two kernels on the decode critical path: `mhc_post_split_h` (post-mix into the four residual streams) followed by `hc_combine_norm` (combine with the earlier pre-mix + RMSNorm). Their outputs are consumed back-to-back, and the pre-mix used by the combine is already available when the post-mix runs, so the pair can be one launch.
